text:
Sam R: Quick sync: compliance wants proof we trimmed KMS admin blast radius. Propose an owner-validation + staged-degrade playbook.

Ivy C: Agree. Minimal waves: discover -> enrich (activity + owners) -> notify -> scoped-degrade -> monitor -> revoke. Keep prod-first.

Marco D: Discovery query (gcloud): `gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies --scope=projects/my-prod --query="role:roles/cloudkms.admin" --format=json` plus cross-ref to BigQuery activity.

infra-bot: Scan summary: 11 bindings found across 3 projects; 4 principals inactive >60d. Report: /reports/kms/27811

Ivy C: Remediation pattern: replace `roles/cloudkms.admin` with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` scoped to key resource names for infra SAs; humans -> owner-only key-admin via OWNER tag.

Sam R: Outreach template draft: short ask + link to ticket + checkbox for temporary re-elevation. Keep 7-day reply window.

sre-oncall: Automation: create GitOps PR with binding change + smoke test that uses staging key. If errors, revert within 20m.

sec-bot: Add weekly cron to re-scan after wave completes.

Marco D: Actions: I’ll produce snapshot + activity table (48h). Ivy -> outreach + evidence bucket (3d). Sam -> coordinate approvals.

Sam R: Thanks. Post PR IDs and tickets here as they land.
